Why it matters

Why earn a credential?

A credential signals verified expertise to employers, boards and clients. The pay difference is measurable. In PCMA's 2025 salary survey, meeting professionals holding the CMP averaged $132,370, compared with $117,780 for those without it, a premium of about 12 percent. Credential holders also stand out in hiring and promotion decisions, and renewal requirements keep their knowledge current across a career.

Compare

How do the CAE, CMP and CEM compare?

CAE
Certified Association Executive
CMP
Certified Meeting Professional
CEM
Certified in Exhibition Management
IssuerASAE, the American Society of Association Executives. CAE certification at ASAEEIC, the Events Industry Council. CMP program at EICIAEE, the International Association of Exhibitions and Events. CEM learning program at IAEE
Who typically earns itAssociation executives, CEOs and senior staffMeeting and event plannersExhibition and trade show organizers
Exam periodTwice a year, in two-week windows in May and DecemberYear-round, by remote proctoring or at a test centerYear-round; each CEM course has its own exam, taken within 90 days of the course
Application fee$500 members, $750 nonmembers (exam included)$375 application plus $535 exam fee, both non-refundable$125 members, $150 nonmembers, plus $329 to $380 per course for members ($470 to $635 for nonmembers)
Application requirements
  • Bachelor's degree, or 8 more years of experience in its place
  • 5 years of association staff experience, or 1 year as a chief staff executive
  • 100 hours of professional development in the past 5 years
  • Pass the CAE exam
  • 36 months of full-time events industry experience in the past 5 years (24 months with a related degree)
  • 25 hours of continuing education in the past 5 years
  • Pass the CMP exam
  • 3 years of full-time industry experience, or a related degree
  • Complete 9 of 13 CEM courses within 3 years
  • Pass each course exam within 90 days of the course
Renewal fee$275 members, $425 nonmembers by Oct. 31; $350 and $500 afterFrom $335$150
Renewal requirements40 credits every 3 years, including 1 ethics credit25 continuing education hours every 5 years15 credit hours every 3 years

Confirm current details with each issuing organization.

Career value

What does each credential open up?

  • CAE

    The standard for association leadership. It is the credential boards look for when hiring CEOs and senior staff, and many association job postings list it as preferred or required.
